parameters.name: LogicalType
parameters.description: The type of ZigBee device that is extracted from the Logical Type Field as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|Table 2.29}}. {{enum}}

parameters.name: ComplexDescriptorSupported
parameters.description: When {{true}}, specifies that the {{object|#.ComplexDescriptor}} object is supported for this ZigBee device.

parameters.name: UserDescriptorSupported
parameters.description: When {{true}}, specifies that the {{object|#.UserDescriptor}} object is supported for this ZigBee device.

parameters.name: FrequencyBand
parameters.description: Specifies the frequency bands that are supported by the underlying IEEE 802.15.4 radio utilized by the ZigBee device. {{list}} {{enum}}

parameters.name: MACCapability
parameters.description: Specifies the IEEE 802.15.4-2003 MAC sub-layer capabilities for this ZigBee device. {{list}} {{enum}}

parameters.name: ManufactureCode
parameters.description: Specifies a manufacturer code that is allocated by the ZigBee Alliance, relating the manufacturer to the device.

parameters.name: MaximumBufferSize
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum buffer size, in {{units}}, of the network sub-layer data unit (NSDU) for this ZigBee device.

parameters.name: MaximumIncomingTransferSize
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum size, in {{units}}, of the application sub-layer data unit (ASDU) that can be transferred to this ZigBee device in one single message transfer.

parameters.name: MaximumOutgoingTransferSize
parameters.description: Specifies the maximum size, in {{units}}, of the application sub-layer data unit (ASDU) that can be transferred from this ZigBee device in one single message transfer.

parameters.name: ServerMask
parameters.description: Specifies the system server capabilities of this ZigBee device. {{list}} {{enum}}

parameters.name: DescriptorCapability
parameters.description: Specifies the descriptor capabilities of this ZigBee device. {{list}} {{enum}}

object.description: The {{object}} object describes the node capabilities of the ZigBee device as defined in {{bibref|ZigBee2007|section 2.3.2.3 Node Descriptor}}.
